prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: CACE school vocabulary level N3 SUBJECT PLUS ACTION. ONE synthetic photorealistic educational studio photograph, natural textures and credible anatomy. Exact approved Catalan construction: LOGOPEDA + PARLAR (Logopeda parlant). Show ONE clearly recognizable subject visibly performing ONLY the named action, rather than just posing. Speaking with open mouth and one natural conversational hand gesture, facing viewer; no words or speech bubbles. A speech therapist in ordinary professional clothing. Pure white seamless background. Minimal necessary context and only the essential prop for the action; no unrelated objects and no second person or animal. Entire subject and necessary props fully inside frame with ample white margin on ALL sides (at least 12 percent, subject occupying only the central 65 percent of frame). For jumping or flying show the feet off the ground; for swimming use a small clearly bounded patch of water with body readable. No action words or symbolic labels. No text, letters, numerals, logos, brands, signatures, speech bubbles, music notes or watermarks, including on clothing, books and screens. Books and writing/drawing supports can be blank; use at most simple non-symbolic marks. No collage or multiple panels. Correct natural anatomy, no extra limbs. School-friendly, no violence, horror or frightening expression. Vary human appearance naturally across the series; this subject's skin tone should be light. Photo children fully and ordinarily clothed. One image only; clearly teach the named subject and action.
